hints.text: 'Feeble' and 'shiver' are our fodder — and this is all letterplay. No need to find any substitutes — just use these letters (or some of them) as the indicators direct!

This is an &lit clue (notice the !? on the end), so the whole clue is both wordplay and definition. This means our answer will be a way of describing a person who's extremely feeble and suffering a shiver.
